content.short: Dolpin enables decentralized storage for asset ownership by individuals, teams, and DAOs.
content.description: Dolpin addresses centralized storage problems by providing fault-tolerant storage through peer-to-peer technology, ensuring permanent file persistence. It protects your privacy by preventing anyone from viewing your files or accessing your assets, not even Dolpin servers. It also advances interoperability for Web3 assets and offers decentralized storage support for DAOs, delivering a robust option for establishing reliable data storage in decentralized ecosystems.
content.meta: Dolpin provides decentralized storage enabling asset ownership for individuals, teams, and DAOs. Discover Dolpin and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
